title: Strict Q, HLDR, and HMS voice contracts

x-q.grounding: exact security, venue, last, bid, ask, volume, displayed units, and timestamp from Godel Q panel only

x-hldr.grounding: exact owner identity, held-security identities, composition fields, report/filing/transaction dates from Godel HLDR panel only
x-hldr.hds_confusion: HLDR is what a fund/company owns; HDS is who owns a security

x-hms.secure_identity: add/remove only exact pre-resolved entities; removal requires exact current membership
